V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] considered himself to be a Ximologist.<ref name="Xim Week">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>
